title: Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00 (VTC over WebSocket)
description: Write draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md defining standalone WebSocket transport for JMAP VTC ephemeral events. The VTC draft defines 7 ephemeral event types but has no subscription mechanism for standalone mode (no Chat WSS). This draft fills that gap with: urn:ietf:params:jmap:vtc:websocket capability, VTCStreamEnable/VTCStreamDisable for call-scoped event subscription by callId, and interop rules for when both Chat WSS and VTC WSS are present.
